title: BUMPERS & MISCELLANEOUS CONTENTS
summary: Contents of UPC 14 (bumpers and miscellaneous): front bumper braces and extension (A2), front bumper and license plate bracket (A3), rear bumper and license plate bezel (B1), and jack stowage (C1). Sketches of the front and rear of the car point to where A2/A3 and B1 apply. Labels, ID plate, shipping items, fluids and sealers are listed in UPC 0 instead.
notes: THE FOLLOWING PARTS ARE LOCATED IN UPC 0: MISCELLANEOUS LABELS & STICKERS; IDENTIFICATION NUMBER PLATE; CUSTOMER VEHICLE PROTECT "O" PLATE; MISCELLANEOUS SHIPPING LIST; SHIPPING PROTECTION (SEAT COVERS, WAX); LUBRICATION, COOLING SYSTEM; GASOLINE & REFRIGERANTS; PLASTIC CEMENTS & SEALERS
